 Blue Eagles gun for strong finishing kick
 DT · 17 November 2026 · 6:07 AM PHT · 2 MIN READ 
 JARED Bahay (right) and the Ateneo Blue Eagles aim to come up with a strong finish after bombing out in the Final Four of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday.
 PHOTOGRAPH COURTESY OF UAAP
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save Ateneo de Manila University is looking to finish its season on a high note after being eliminated from Final Four contention following a disappointing loss to University of Santo Tomas (ust) on Sunday in Season 89 of the University Athletic Association of the Philippines men’s basketball tournament.
 Blue Eagles skipper Jared Bahay said being able to compete this season is already a victory as they faced uncertainty following the deaths of their teammates Rene Baterbonia and Divine Adili last June.
 Although they fell short of making it to the semifinals, it was still a mission accomplished for them as they were able to post five wins in their first 13 games while putting up a gallant stand against league heavyweights.

 Games today:
 Mark Escarlote · 28 October 2026 
 The Blue Eagles will be closing their season against University of the East on 25 November, and Bahay vowed to do everything to deliver a strong finishing kick.
 “In the first place, we’re not supposed to be here. But we fought together because we really wanted to play,” Bahay said after their 84-89 setback to the Growling Tigers, a game marred by shoving matches between him and Collins Akowe and UST coach Pido Jarencio and the Ateneo coaches.
 “We are just grateful to everyone who supported us.”
 Bahay said the tragic deaths of Baterbonia and Adili put them through an emotional roller coaster as they were unsure whether they would still be able to see action.
